info.name: iWallet LAS Loan (via API Gateway)
info.description: End-to-end API collection through the API gateway. Scope (programManagerId, groupId, tagId) and every request value come from collection variables.

exec: pm.test("login ok", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200));
pm.collectionVariables.set("access_token", pm.response.json().access_token);
